entities.summary: Sir Archibald Alison, 1st Baronet, was a Scottish advocate (attorney) and historian. He held several prominent legal appointments. He was the younger son of the Episcopalian cleric and author Archibald Alison. His elder brother was the physician and social reformer William Pulteney Alison.
